Screen checkConfirm in Vanderbilt's Oracle or UKG during a recorded demo: the Individual Compensation quick action name; plan names (Lump sum payment, Bonus, staff supplements); the Net, Amount, Process separately, and Ongoing field labels; that a regular HCM (not a super-user) sees Our Workforce and this quick action.

1 · Intro

When to use it.

A staff supplement pays someone extra for extra duties over a period, such as acting in a vacant leadership role at $2,000 a month until the backfill. It is recurring, so it keeps paying each payroll until its end date.

Use this whenSomeone takes on extra duties for a period of time.

2 · Walk through

Step by step.

Follow along in Oracle HCM. Check off each step as you go.

Which supplement (from the award compensation guide)
Plan (code)Use for
Administrative Supplement (ADS)Acting or interim in an administrative vacancy while a search runs. Expected less than a year.
Interim Appointment Supplement (INTERIM)Same situation, expected 12 months or more.
Temporary Supplement (TEMPSUP)Short-term additional responsibilities.
Not forFaculty, post-docs, students, or temps. Faculty have their own supplements.

Before you submit

The same four checks on every pay-impacting transaction. Draft: the owner for this area confirms anything marked To confirm.

Attach

  • Interim pay letter, filed as a Compensation Letters document record If finance asks

To confirmWhether the letter is required for every supplement.

Check

Read every field back against the source document: person, effective date, position, hours, pay, and costing.

  • The plan is the supplement your finance partner asked for.
  • The amount is per payroll, and it is filled in.
  • Start date is the first day of the target payroll month.
  • An end date is set, or Ongoing is on with a reminder to end it.

Cutoff

Monthly (exempt) pay: the change must be fully approved by the HCM Transaction Cutoff, the 18th in most months and earlier in December. Check the HR/Payroll Calendar. Pending approvals do not pay. A change still waiting in approvals at the cutoff misses that payroll.

Who does what

  • Who starts it: You.
  • Who approves: To confirm: the approval chain for this transaction.
  • What happens next: It pays every payroll until it ends. Someone has to end an ongoing supplement.

Watch-outs

  • Ongoing supplements keep paying until someone ends them. Set a reminder.
  • Guide dated 01/17/2023. Confirm current plan names with finance.

Official documentation

Vendor documentation describes the standard process. Vanderbilt's setup, codes, and rules in this course take priority.

  • Oracle: Individual compensation one-time payment plans (opens in a new tab)
  • Oracle: Run Types, incl. Process Separately (US Payroll) (opens in a new tab)

HCM Academy job aid · Compensation Management

Add a staff supplement

Use when: Someone takes on extra duties for a period of time. · System: Oracle HCM

  1. Open Individual Compensation for the employee.
  2. Click Add, then choose Add staff supplement.
  3. Plan: choose the supplement type.
  4. Enter the amount.
  5. Leave Process separately set to Yes.
  6. Start date: the first day of the target payroll month (for example, Nov 1).
  7. Set the end date.
    • Unknown end: leave Ongoing on.
    • Known end: turn Ongoing off and enter the end date (for example, Dec 31).
  8. Click Save and confirm every field.
  9. Click Continue for comments or attachments, then Submit.
Which supplement (from the award compensation guide)
Plan (code)Use for
Administrative Supplement (ADS)Acting or interim in an administrative vacancy while a search runs. Expected less than a year.
Interim Appointment Supplement (INTERIM)Same situation, expected 12 months or more.
Temporary Supplement (TEMPSUP)Short-term additional responsibilities.
Not forFaculty, post-docs, students, or temps. Faculty have their own supplements.

Before you submit

  • Attach: Interim pay letter, filed as a Compensation Letters document record (if finance asks). To confirm: Whether the letter is required for every supplement.
  • Check: The plan is the supplement your finance partner asked for. The amount is per payroll, and it is filled in. Start date is the first day of the target payroll month. An end date is set, or Ongoing is on with a reminder to end it.
  • Cutoff: Fully approved by the HCM Transaction Cutoff (the 18th in most months, earlier in December). Pending approvals do not pay.

Watch-outs

  • Ongoing supplements keep paying until someone ends them. Set a reminder.
  • Guide dated 01/17/2023. Confirm current plan names with finance.
